user.title: Swiss Solar Forecast
user.description: Where is the plant? Your Home Assistant location is pre-filled: move the marker onto the roof, or type a street address (the federal address register knows every address of Switzerland). The next step lists the roof planes of that building from the Sonnendach cadastre of the Federal Office of Energy, with orientation, tilt, area and suitability; you pick yours or enter a plane by hand. One entry is one plane: set up a second entry for a roof facing another way.

data.name: Name of the plant or plane

roof.title: Roof plane
roof.description: {count} roof plane(s) at {place} in the Sonnendach cadastre, largest first: orientation, tilt, area, suitability class (1 low … 5 top) and the long-term electricity yield of the whole plane. Pick yours; the last entry (—) lets you enter a plane by hand, for a roof the cadastre does not know or a ground-mounted plant.

plane.title: The plane's figures
plane.description: Roof: {roof}. Orientation and tilt come from the cadastre; correct them if you know better. Enter the installed peak power of this plane in kWp (the cadastre's area would hold about {kwp_hint} kWp with modern modules). Losses cover wiring, inverter, soiling and mismatch (14 % is a usual figure). The inverter limit clips the AC power (0 = none). Damping scales the result, for calibration against your real yield.

reconfigure.title: Move the plant
reconfigure.description: Move the marker or type another address; the roof planes there are listed next, then the figures. The entry keeps its entities, their ids and history.

reconfigure_roof.title: Roof plane
reconfigure_roof.description: {count} roof plane(s) at {place} in the Sonnendach cadastre, largest first. Pick yours, or the last entry (—) to enter the plane by hand.

reconfigure_plane.title: The plane's figures
reconfigure_plane.description: Roof: {roof}. Orientation and tilt come from the cadastre; the other figures are the entry's current ones.

error.cannot_connect: The federal geo service could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.no_match: No address matches the text. Try street and place, or move the marker instead.

abort.already_configured: This roof plane is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: The MeteoSwiss open data could not be read. Check the internet connection and try again.

init.title: The plane's figures
init.description: Peak power, orientation, tilt, losses, inverter limit and damping of this plane. Changing a value reloads the entry; entity ids and history are kept. Use damping to calibrate: if the forecast is 10 % too high over a few sunny weeks, set 0.9. To move the plant or pick another roof, use Reconfigure in the entry's menu.

forecast_unreachable.title: Swiss Solar Forecast: forecast not readable
forecast_unreachable.description: The MeteoSwiss open data could not be read for several refreshes in a row ({error}). Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the MeteoSwiss service is down or has changed. The sensors stay unavailable until then and recover on their own; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.
